text:
maria: FYI — a new customer hit confusing errors in the JS sample app during onboarding. They couldn't tell whether to retry or change auth token.

kevin: Can you paste the payload they saw?

maria: Sure — copied from browser console: 
{ status: 401, message: 'request failed' }

kevin: Hmm I see 'status: 401' but message is 'request failed' with no hint. That's bad for DX.

alex: Triage: we currently map 401->AuthError (typed), 429->RateLimitError, 5xx->ServerError. But our sample app strips typed error and renders generic message.

elaine: That's the UX bug — we intentionally normalized for HTTP libs but that removed the 'retryable' hint.

maria: Proposed: keep typed exceptions in SDK surface and add 'retryable' boolean + 'action_hint' string. Example:

```json
{
  "type": "RateLimitError",
  "status": 429,
  "retryable": true,
  "retry_after": 120,
  "action_hint": "backoff 120s or switch to dedicated plan",
  "message": "Too many requests — quota exceeded"
}
```

kevin: +1. Also add explicit onboarding copy in sample-app that shows auth refresh flow and shows the error fields.

alex: For parity: Go SDK already exposes typed errors; JS should match. We also need to ensure error.message is human-friendly and not just 'request failed'.

maria: Who can change sample-app and JS SDK error normalization? @kevin you ok to own sample-app PR? :pray: 

kevin: I can do sample-app docs + a small code change to avoid swallowing properties. I'll open PR tonight.

elaine: I'll update SDK issue tracker to add 'retryable' field and 'action_hint' to the error spec, and add unit tests for serialization.

alex: One more: metrics — surface a histogram of error types in console so onboarding guides can detect common failures.

maria: Nice. For immediate fix, change sample-app to show raw error object if DEBUG=true. That should unblock customers.

kevin: opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/57 (WIP)

deploy-bot: demo app redeploy queued for preview env.

elaine: tagging docs folks — @nina can you add a short blurb to onboarding guide about interpreting SDK errors?

nina: Yep will add small section + sample code snippet.

maria: Thanks everyone — let's converge on the error shape by EOW. :thumbsup:
